in_sanskrit.name: अनुलेखा
in_sanskrit.meaning: अनु (anu) - after, following; लेख (lekha) - mark, sign, symbol

in_hindi.name: अनुलेखा
in_hindi.meaning: अनु (anu) + लेखा (lekha) = अगला लेख (agla lekha) = next mark

in_tamil.name: அனுலேகா
in_tamil.meaning: அனு (anu) + லேகா (lekha) = அடிகள் அடிக்கல் (adiyal adikkal) = next, subsequent

in_telugu.name: అనులేఖ
in_telugu.meaning: అను (anu) + లేఖ (lekha) = అదేశ లేఖ (adesa lekha) = next mark

in_marathi.name: Anulekha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anulekha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anu means 'new' and lekha means 'writing' or 'record'. The name Anulekha signifies a unique record, something unprecedented and unparalleled.

in_bengali.name: Anulekha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Unique, Unparalleled
in_bengali.long_meaning: Anulekha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Anu means 'new' and lekha means 'writing' or 'record'. The name Anulekha signifies a unique record, something unprecedented and unparalleled.
